# Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(effectsize)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Data Loading

Our data loading relies on a pre-processed file saved as an RData `data.RData`

```{r, echo=FALSE}
load("~/Documents/GitHub/VirtEcom/data.RData")
df_clean <- as.data.frame(df) %>%
  mutate(
    run = as.integer(run),
    step = as.integer(step),
    max.triads.per.worker = as.numeric(max.triads.per.worker),
    credit.limit.base = as.numeric(credit.limit.base),
    firms.with.commercial.capability = as.numeric(firms.with.commercial.capability),
    firms.with.digital.capability = as.numeric(firms.with.digital.capability),
    firms.with.ai.capability = as.numeric(firms.with.ai.capability),
    mean.capability.count = as.numeric(mean.capability.count)
  )

# Filtrar corte transversal en estado estacionario (Tick 2000)
df_ss <- df_clean %>%
  filter(step == 2000)

```

# 4. Results

## 4.1 Emergence of Collective Know‑How

### Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
df_ss %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_CK = mean(mean.firm.ck),
    SD_CK   = sd(mean.firm.ck),
    Min_CK  = min(mean.firm.ck),
    Max_CK  = max(mean.firm.ck)
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

### Temporal Evolution of Collective Know‑How

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
p_ck_time <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(step, max.triads.per.worker) %>%
  summarise(
    CK = mean(mean.firm.ck),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      step,
      CK,
      color = factor(max.triads.per.worker)
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .9) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation Step",
    y = "Mean Collective Know-How",
    color = "MT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_ck_time
```

### Collective Know‑How Heatmap

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
p_ck_heatmap <- df_ss %>%
  group_by(
    max.triads.per.worker,
    credit.limit.base
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    CK = mean(mean.firm.ck),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      factor(max.triads.per.worker),
      factor(credit.limit.base),
      fill = CK
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile(color="white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    x = "Max Triads",
    y = "Credit Limit",
    fill = "CK"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_ck_heatmap
```

### Factorial ANOVA of Collective Know‑How

```{r}
fit_ck <- aov(
  mean.firm.ck ~
    factor(max.triads.per.worker) *
    factor(credit.limit.base),
  data = df_ss
)

summary(fit_ck)

eta_squared(
  fit_ck,
  partial = TRUE
)
```

### Interpretation

The results indicate that collective know‑how emerges primarily from cognitive coordination structures. Cognitive constraints explain nearly all observed variation in collective know‑how, whereas access to credit has negligible explanatory power.

---

## 4.2 From Collective Know‑How to Innovation Capabilities

### Relationship Between CK and Capability Formation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
p_ck_cap <- df_ss %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      mean.firm.ck,
      mean.capability.count
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha=.25) +
  geom_smooth(
    method="gam",
    color="red",
    linewidth=1
  ) +
  labs(
    x="Mean Collective Know‑How",
    y="Mean Capability Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_ck_cap
```

### Interpretation

Capability formation exhibits strong nonlinear threshold behaviour. Capability accumulation accelerates only after collective know‑how surpasses minimum coordination thresholds.

---

## 4.3 Joint Effects of Cognitive Constraints and Credit on Innovation Capabilities

### Evolution of Capability Indicators

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
p_caps <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(
    step,
    max.triads.per.worker
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    commercial =
      mean(firms.with.commercial.capability),

    digital =
      mean(firms.with.digital.capability),

    ai =
      mean(firms.with.ai.capability),

    capability =
      mean(mean.capability.count),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    commercial:capability,
    names_to="metric",
    values_to="value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      step,
      value,
      color=factor(max.triads.per.worker)
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~metric,
    scales="free_y"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_caps
```

```{r}

crear_heatmap <- function(data, var_col, titulo_panel, leyenda_titulo) {

  data %>%
    group_by(
      max.triads.per.worker,
      credit.limit.base
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      val_mean = mean(.data[[var_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = factor(max.triads.per.worker),
        y = factor(credit.limit.base),
        fill = val_mean
      )
    ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(
      title = titulo_panel,
      x = "Max Triads (MT)",
      y = "Credit Limit",
      fill = leyenda_titulo
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

p_hm_comm <- crear_heatmap(
  df_ss,
  "firms.with.commercial.capability",
  "Commercial Capability",
  "Firms"
)

p_hm_dig <- crear_heatmap(
  df_ss,
  "firms.with.digital.capability",
  "Digital Capability",
  "Firms"
)

p_hm_ai <- crear_heatmap(
  df_ss,
  "firms.with.ai.capability",
  "AI Capability",
  "Firms"
)

p_hm_cap <- crear_heatmap(
  df_ss,
  "mean.capability.count",
  "Mean Capability Count",
  "Count"
)

```

### Factorial ANOVAs

```{r}
capability_vars <- c(
  "firms.with.commercial.capability",
  "firms.with.digital.capability",
  "firms.with.ai.capability",
  "mean.capability.count"
)

anova_results <- list()
effect_results <- list()

for(v in capability_vars){

  fit <- aov(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        v,
        "~ factor(max.triads.per.worker) * factor(credit.limit.base)"
      )
    ),
    data=df_ss
  )

  anova_results[[v]] <- summary(fit)
  effect_results[[v]] <- eta_squared(
    fit,
    partial=TRUE
  )
}

effect_results
```

---

```{r}

extract_anova <- function(var_name, data){

  fit <- aov(
    as.formula(
      paste(
        var_name,
        "~ factor(max.triads.per.worker) * factor(credit.limit.base)"
      )
    ),
    data = data
  )

  aov_tab <- as.data.frame(
    summary(fit)[[1]]
  )[1:3, ]

  eta_tab <- as.data.frame(
    eta_squared(
      fit,
      partial = TRUE
    )
  )

  tibble(
    Outcome = var_name,
    Effect = c(
      "Max Triads (MT)",
      "Credit Limit",
      "MT × Credit"
    ),
    Df = aov_tab$Df,
    F = round(aov_tab$`F value`, 3),
    p = signif(aov_tab$`Pr(>F)`, 3),

    Eta2_p = round(
      eta_tab$Eta2_partial,
      3
    )
  )
}

outcomes <- c(
  "mean.firm.ck",
  "firms.with.commercial.capability",
  "firms.with.digital.capability",
  "firms.with.ai.capability",
  "mean.capability.count"
)

anova_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  outcomes,
  extract_anova,
  data = df_ss
)

anova_results %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = recode(
      Outcome,
      "mean.firm.ck" = "Collective Know-How",
      "firms.with.commercial.capability" = "Commercial Capability",
      "firms.with.digital.capability" = "Digital Capability",
      "firms.with.ai.capability" = "AI Capability",
      "mean.capability.count" = "Mean Capability Count"
    ),
    p = ifelse(
      p < .001,
      "<0.001",
      format(round(p,3), nsmall = 3)
    )
  ) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    caption =
      "Factorial ANOVA and partial effect sizes for collective know-how and innovation capability outcomes"
  )
```




## 4.4 System-Level Outcomes

### Market Structure

```{r}
df_ss %>%
  summarise(
    Firms = mean(number.of.firms),
    Products = mean(count.products),
    NetCapital = mean(mean.net.capital),
    Debt = mean(sum.debt.of.firms)
  ) %>%
  kable(digits=3)
```

### Interpretation

Differences in coordination capacity not only affect capability formation but also generate distinct system-wide outcomes regarding firm survival, productive diversity and capital accumulation.

---

# Discussion-Oriented Summary

1. Cognitive constraints strongly determine collective know‑how.
2. Collective know‑how exhibits threshold dynamics.
3. Innovation capabilities emerge from collective know‑how rather than directly from credit.
4. Financial resources amplify outcomes but do not create collective know‑how.
5. Collective know‑how acts as the generative mechanism linking distributed worker knowledge to organizational innovation capabilities.
